verdict.rationale: Extend documents structured extraction with a typed schema (extend-docs-10), confidence scores (extend-docs-11), and explicit table/checkbox/handwriting detection (extend-docs-22), which together produce typed JSON output suitable for downstream loading, and community feedback confirms satisfaction with extraction accuracy (extend-comm-1). However there's no explicit documentation of database-load workflows, CSV/row-level typing guarantees, or handling of messy table structures (merged cells, multi-page tables) without manual cleanup. Missing for 10: evidence of direct DB/warehouse load integration, documented handling of complex/multi-page table edge cases, and independent benchmarking specifically on table extraction fidelity.
